bills.summary: Digital Safety Act: under-16 social media ban, duties on AI chatbots and a new Digital Safety Commission.
Age verification or estimation for commercial pornography sites.
Duty of care for platforms toward minors (Conservative private member's bill).
Rules and transparency measures for online deepfakes (Liberal private member's bill).
Mandatory minimum sentences for child sexual abuse material offences, using the notwithstanding clause.
Protecting Victims Act: criminal law package including sexual deepfakes.
Combatting Hate Act: hate crime offence and hate symbol offence.
Replaces PIPEDA Part 1 with the Protecting Privacy and Consumer Data Act, enforced by the same commission as C-34.
Health IT interoperability and a ban on data blocking by health IT vendors.
Telecom security powers and the Critical Cyber Systems Protection Act for federally regulated critical infrastructure.
Lawful Access Act, 2026: new police and CSIS access powers and duties on electronic service providers.
Strong Borders Act: border, policing and information-sharing measures.
Protection Against Online Fraud Act: duties on platforms to remove fraudulent content (Conservative private member's bill).
Creates a federal Financial Crimes Agency.
Budget implementation: Stablecoin Act, Consumer-Driven Banking Act, bank fraud duties and repeal of the digital services tax.
Budget implementation: includes crypto-asset reporting rules from 2027.
National framework on sports betting advertising.
Strong and Free Elections Act: election deepfakes, ban on crypto and anonymous donations, party privacy policies.
Affordability bill whose Part 4 sets the privacy regime for federal political parties.
Requires verified mobile coverage data and an updated national spectrum framework that prioritizes rural areas.
Red tape bill amending 31 statutes, including digital publication of regulations and spectrum access.
